title: python/src/lichen/loadng/messages.py: Missing hop_count range validation on parsing
description: Line 137: RREP.from_bytes() reads hop_count as a raw byte (0-255) without validating against MAX_HOP_LIMIT (15). Same asymmetry as RREQ - to_bytes() validates (line 117-118) but from_bytes() does not. Malicious sender can inject out-of-spec values.
